'''2010 Worlds Day 2 Jonny Chu DS Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Jonny Chu]] at [[2010 World Championship]] (Day 2).

Deck name on sheet: Darth Sith. Transcription note: very rough handwriting; sheet Name "Chu" only (same player as LS p20 and Day 3)

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi / Their Fire Has Gone Out Of The Universe]]
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
